convertedNpcRosterSources.markdown: # Belavadös Faction Field Ledger Prepared for table use: Horundar 24, Sigranday. ## Field Rules - Faction names are treated as living Belavadös powers, offices, cults, orders, and syndicates. - Public routes are rail, caravan, ferry, skyship, steamship, submarine, and regulated portal passage. - Ichor is useful, addictive, valuable, and dangerous. Diluted forms circulate openly; pure forms create black-market leverage, mutation, ritual power, and corruption. - Settlement danger, province government, resident peoples, and available transit decide how quickly a job turns public. - Thalryss legal custom allows crime to become respectable when the correct forms, fees, intent records, target classes, collateral declarations, and cleanup bonds are satisfied. ## Active Faction Dockets ### The Crucible Wardens - Atlas anchors: Aelthéon (Falthrakar); Dorghalun (Kharvathen); Bronzewake (Virelport) - Settlement pressure: High x7, Elevated x6; common terrain: Beach and grass with water, Partial forest, Farming - Routes and table use: Routes: Caravan, Train, Submarine, Steamship. Use route access, fees, danger, and settlement type as leverage. ### The Obsidian Diadem - Atlas anchors: Bloodmire (Khorvaak); Eldaréss (Vaelmyrith); Amazuul (Zal’tharuun) - Settlement pressure: Elevated x10, High x8; common terrain: Beach and grass with water, Beach and reefs with water, Farming - Routes and table use: Routes: Submarine, Steamship, Caravan, Train. Use route access, fees, danger, and settlement type as leverage. ### The Choral Synod - Atlas anchors: Elarion Pastures (Aelwynora); Bleasacia (Iazethas); Auralisthra (Lun’tharavé); Abyrros (Thalryss) - Settlement pressure: Low x12, High x9; common terrain: Beach and grass with water, Partial forest, Farming - Routes and table use: Routes: Caravan, Train, Steamship, Submarine. Use route access, fees, danger, and settlement type as leverage. ### The Brass Concordat - Atlas anchors: Ael'voryn (Astraevos); Dunvyr (Kaelvorrin); Avarélyn (Valerune) - Settlement pressure: Low x10, Moderate x7; common terrain: Partial forest, Farming, Beach and grass with water - Routes and table use: Routes: Caravan, Train, Steamship, Submarine. Use route access, fees, danger, and settlement type as leverage. ### The Nefaric Veil - Atlas anchors: Elarûneth (Drakmorren); Caelorynth (Jor’maelis); Blacktide Reach (Marrowynd) - Settlement pressure: Severe x8, Moderate x7; common terrain: Beach and grass with water, Partial forest, Beach and reefs with water - Routes and table use: Routes: Submarine, Steamship, Caravan, Train. Use route access, fees, danger, and settlement type as leverage. ### The Black-Maw Myriad - Atlas anchors: Abyrros (Thalryss); Blackwake Isles (Thalryss); Dreadcurrent (Thalryss); Grimwater Reach (Thalryss) - Settlement pressure: Elevated x9, High x9; common terrain: Beach and grass with water, Partial forest, Farming - Routes and table use: Routes: Caravan, Train, Steamship, Submarine. Use route access, fees, danger, and settlement type as leverage. - Thalryss legal-cover contact: Roz, Sub-33 Counter, Leviamor. ### The Glasswell Institute - Atlas anchors: Loxvire (Bravelyn); Cindrau (Ceulrithan); Glysera (Vuelmora) - Settlement pressure: Low x8, Moderate x7; common terrain: Beach and grass with water, Partial forest, Farming - Routes and table use: Routes: Caravan, Train, Steamship, Submarine. Use route access, fees, danger, and settlement type as leverage. ### The Freeblade Veil - Atlas anchors: Drakesylva (Aelvanyr); Aelgrove (Eldermere); Aelmyrwald (Sylvavéryn) - Settlement pressure: Low x14, Moderate x10; common terrain: Farming, Partial forest, Deep forest - Routes and table use: Routes: Caravan, Train, Ferry, Steamship. Use route access, fees, danger, and settlement type as leverage. ### The Cog-Sanctum Synod - Atlas anchors: Aelvyréa (Gruddirynn); Dorghalun (Kharvathen); Drakzhul (Zharvokh) - Settlement pressure: High x8, Severe x8; common terrain: Beach and grass with water, Farming, Beach and reefs with water - Routes and table use: Routes: Caravan, Train, Steamship, Submarine. Use route access, fees, danger, and settlement type as leverage. ### The Regent Lattice - Atlas anchors: Elarion Pastures (Aelwynora); Ael'voryn (Astraevos); Glattonica (Earrorim) - Settlement pressure: Moderate x9, Severe x7; common terrain: Beach and grass with water, Partial forest, Beach and reefs with water - Routes and table use: Routes: Caravan, Train, Steamship, Submarine. Use route access, fees, danger, and settlement type as leverage. ## Roz, Sub-33 Counter Roz is the clerk players meet when they need a crime made legal, a legal act made survivable, or a dead signature made impossible. She belongs to Leviamor, Thalryss, and works where wet cargo claims, prize shares, false witnesses, cleanup bonds, and registered violence become paper with teeth.
